prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1335; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The mechanism described, a forceful bracing of the outstretched hand against the steering wheel and door frame, is consistent with the wrist fracture subsequently identified. Radiographs and the physical examination findings together clearly confirm the fracture, with localized swelling, tenderness over the distal radius, and restricted range of motion at the time of initial evaluation. There is no record of prior injury or treatment to this body region. Care was delivered over twelve visits and followed a typical course: immobilization, supervised progression of range-of-motion exercises, and follow-up imaging to confirm healing alignment. Visit frequency tapered as pain and function improved, and the patient is now discharged to independent home exercise. Two similar billing entries recorded on the same date of service are currently under review for accuracy.
